name: OR
description: OR returns TRUE if any argument is TRUE, and FALSE if all arguments are FALSE.
tldr: OR checks if ANY condition is TRUE.

basicExample.description: Check if any condition is true
basicExample.explanation: Returns TRUE if either A1 > 100 or B1 > 100.

advancedExamples.title: OR with IF
advancedExamples.description: Use OR within IF for alternative criteria
advancedExamples.explanation: Returns "Executive" if either condition is met.

howItWorks: OR evaluates all conditions and returns TRUE if at least one condition is TRUE.

howToSteps.name: Define conditions
howToSteps.text: Determine conditions where any being true is sufficient.

howToSteps.name: Press Enter
howToSteps.text: The result is TRUE or FALSE.

limitations: Only one condition needs to be TRUE for OR to return TRUE.
For ALL conditions to be TRUE, use AND instead.

commonErrors.fix: Ensure all arguments evaluate to TRUE/FALSE.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: OR works identically in Google Sheets.

faq.question: How many conditions can OR handle?
faq.answer: OR can handle up to 255 conditions in Excel.

faq.question: What if I have no conditions?
faq.answer: OR with no arguments returns FALSE.
